summary.source: Live code, CI/deploy evidence, hosted identities, seeded simulations, and game-loop review.

profile.rubric: product, game-loop, realism, and release gates
profile.staging: Exact immutable candidate on staging before production.

items.title: Pages can publish a browser-red SHA
items.executionEvidence: deploy-pages now runs the full Playwright browser suite before artifact upload; the profile assertion reads PLAYER_DEVELOPMENT_PROFILE.version; focused workflow/security checks, 54/54 browser tests, and the 1,280/1,280 canonical receipt pass.
items.premise: CI 32680529030 failed a stale ratings-profile assertion while deploy 32680529029 published bb77f84 because deploy-pages omits browser tests.
items.fix: Use the exported profile and gate deploy on browser smoke with a workflow-contract test.

L2.recipe: Fix assertion and make browser CI a deploy prerequisite.

items.title: One click resolves the entire postseason
items.executionEvidence: Postseason state persists by round, resolves one controlled-team game per command, preserves exact plans across save/resume, and batch delegation loops through every gate; focused postseason tests and the canonical matrix pass.
items.premise: The weekly plan ends after the regular season; GameSession resolves all playoffs and the Super Bowl in one transaction.
items.fix: Persist and resolve one playoff round at a time with a visible decision beat.

L2.recipe: Implement round-by-round postseason state and tests.

items.title: Next actions target retired Settings surfaces
items.executionEvidence: public/lib/gameplayNavigation.js is the shared phase-to-surface authority consumed by decision, consequence, chapter, and weekly-plan routes; exact-target focused tests and browser routing pass.
items.premise: Staff and facilities moved to Boardroom but gmDecisionAuthority and season chapters retain generic or Settings destinations.
items.fix: Share one tested stage-to-surface map across all routers.

L2.recipe: Centralize exact destinations and prove every target exists.

items.title: Owners all invest while cash compounds without a sink
items.executionEvidence: Owner capital now models football-operations liquidity, obligations, runway, trait-weighted appetite, bounded distributions, and factor receipts. Year-zero willingness calibrates to 19/32 and year-40 cash p90/max to $152.0M/$201.2M with no club at the facility ceiling; deterministic 1/8/15/40-year gates pass.
items.premise: Five seeds put all 32 owners above the year-zero threshold; max cash grows $190M to $1.655B and facility mean 72.51 to 89.80 by year 40.
items.fix: Model liquidity runway, owner distributions, calibrated appetite, and factor receipts; gate long horizons.

L2.recipe: Recalibrate capital policy, add a sink, receipts, and distribution gates.

items.title: Release proof does not identify the final candidate
items.executionEvidence: Source and browser suites are green. Final immutable desktop/mobile/theme visual receipt, stable staging provenance, and exact production identity are pending in the active release wave.
items.premise: Visual QA names orphaned 8eac388, hosted origins name S93 fe39e5f, and mobile-parity proof is absent.
items.fix: Capture final desktop/mobile/themes, prove exact staging, rerun gates, then promote the same identity.

L2.recipe: Bind visual, mobile, staging, and production proof to one SHA.

items.title: Unkeyed checksum is called forgery detection
items.executionEvidence: Public copy now distinguishes accidental-corruption checks from authorship authentication; optional PBKDF2-derived HMAC verification is versioned, legacy-compatible, and covered by focused security tests plus the canonical matrix.
items.premise: FNV-1a stored beside an editable save detects corruption but cannot authenticate authorship.
items.fix: Correct the claim and add optional passphrase-derived Web Crypto authentication.

L2.recipe: Honest copy plus versioned optional HMAC and legacy support.

items.title: Deep realism times out without partial artifacts
items.executionEvidence: The scheduled realism job now has aligned 125/90-minute budgets, writes incremental progress, and uploads progress/report/JSON artifacts under always(); workflow contract tests and the canonical matrix pass.
items.premise: Run 32697416345 hit its 60-minute step limit despite a 90-minute job, losing completed evidence.
items.fix: Align budgets, persist progress, upload always, and test the workflow contract.

L2.recipe: Preserve partial evidence and align timeout contracts.

phantomsRejected.evidence: Recurring AI investment and degradation exist.
Deployment authorization is not a lifecycle flip.
